Write a survival manual for someone in Dubai. Assume, all civilization and industry is gone. Make a concise guide focusing on native edible animals, plants, fruits, fungi etc, and their storage. Also mention technology they can salvage from cities to build security systems, water purification systems etc.

Your stories should have engaging characters, unique plot points and vivid descriptions. For example, you could create an adventure story about a group of travelers in a fantastical world, or a mystery set in a modern city. Feel free to use your imagination!
